gcd (gcd n m) m = gcd m (gcd n m) [by comm] = gcd n m [by gcd_gcd_self_right_right].

2. rw [Nat.gcd_gcd_self_right_right] (or just gcd_gcd_self_right_right) to turn that into gcd n m.

Thus the proof is two rewrites.
